Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished production bitmap background for a native futuristic desktop voice assistant, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: an exquisite advanced optical-glass surface with subtle holographic energy reflections, cinematic sci-fi assistant aesthetic, original sophisticated futuristic material artwork.
Scene/backdrop: opaque near-black deep navy #06111c, seamless full-frame background with shallow optical glass depth and incredibly fine etched microcircuit traces.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3 ratio; the LEFT 65 percent and center remain very calm nearly empty dark negative space for readable native text. Sparse cyan and ice-blue luminous traces are concentrated only around the RIGHT perimeter and BOTTOM perimeter, refined visual depth at edges. Keep every edge detail subordinate, no focal orb because separate art will be overlaid.
Lighting/mood: premium restrained photoreal glass, delicate cool reflected light, confident immersive futuristic AI ambience; no bright broad flares.
Color palette: navy-black #06111c, smoked blue glass, luminous cool cyan #5cecf7, tiny ice-blue edge highlights.
Materials/textures: subtly layered optical glass, etched microscopic lines, controlled satin specularity.
Constraints: artwork only, not a screenshot, not a mockup, absolutely no text, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, controls, charts, gauges, UI panels, icons, characters, helmet, robots, or focal objects. Opaque rectangular image.
